connector.name: MCP Ratchet Clinical Charting
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for clinical charting with Claude - document patient visits to EMR
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-ratchet-clinical-charting. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the m2ai-mcp-servers account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.description: EMR API key (required for production mode)
